# Curi Curi

Curio Curio's second record is the one where the *jangle* finally gives way
to something heavier. I first heard it at [Bandcamp Friday](https://curiocurio.bandcamp.com/album/curi-curi)
and have not stopped.

## The songs

1. "Opener" sets the pace
2. "Middle" drifts
